name: Listening To God
overview: Scripture reveals that listening to God involves a deliberate and humble seeking of His guidance, as seen in the Psalmist’s plea to be taught God's ways and paths. Genuine listening is marked by a heart that delights in the Lord and treasures His commandments, leading to a deeper understanding and blessing. Jesus emphasizes the importance of attentiveness to His words, promising that those who truly hear will receive more revelation, while His sheep recognize and follow His voice, confirming their relationship with Him.
